# Sneh Sarees

> Authentic Kota Doria Handloom Sarees directly from Kota, Rajasthan, India. Handcrafted pure Zari, Cotton Silk, Tissue, and traditional Rajasthani sarees with pan-India free delivery.

## Core Navigation & Links

- [Home & Catalog](https://www.snehsarees.in/#/): Explore featured Kota Doria handloom saree collections.
- [Shop All Sarees](https://www.snehsarees.in/#/viewall/all): Browse all Kota Doria, Cotton, Silk, and Zari sarees.
- [Bulk Enquiries](https://www.snehsarees.in/#/bulk): Saree orders for weddings, celebrations, and bulk gifting.
- [Our Story](https://www.snehsarees.in/#/home): Heritage, craftsmanship, and weaving tradition of Kota Doria artisans.
- [Contact Support](https://www.snehsarees.in/#/home): WhatsApp customer support (+91 94610 37123) and store location in Kota, Rajasthan.
